Well it came out that my brother confessed to Taylor that he was gay and had been “having feelings for another man.” They divorced after this and my brother started a new relationship with this man. This was three years ago and now Chris is marrying this same guy. The thing is, I’ve been witness to the devastation that this caused to his ex wife and son. I just explained that I couldn’t be there after everything that happened and I hung up. I think I’m being reasonable but my judgement is also clouded. Be honest.
